topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the session by connecting histopathology practicals to molecular mechanisms and detailing the day's learning outcomes.

topics.label: Viral discovery of oncogenes and transformation assays
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace how the study of transforming retroviruses revealed cellular oncogenes and established laboratory assays to assess cell transformation.

topics.label: Oncogenes, tumor suppressor genes, and cell cycle control
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the classifications, mutational behaviors, and regulatory impacts of oncogenes and tumor suppressor genes on cell cycle checkpoints.

topics.label: Mechanisms and consequences of genetic instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics investigate the cellular failures in DNA repair, replication, and chromosome segregation that generate sequence and chromosomal instability in cancer.

topics.label: Stepwise tumor progression and hereditary cancer predisposition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how the sequential acquisition or inherited transmission of driver mutations accelerates multi-step tumorigenesis.

topics.label: Lecture wrap-up and reading recommendations
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session with book recommendations and an outlook on the upcoming lecture on the hallmarks of cancer.
